messages:
maya: @here 20M requests across hosted + dedicated this week — insane! :tada:
sam: wait what, seriously? that's our weekly or total?
maya: total since launch this month. dashboard shows `requests_total = 20,000,000` (will grab screenshot)
diego: :eyes: that's huge. well done ops + infra teams :raised_hands:
leah: can we have a tiny celebration? virtual confetti jar? :confetti_ball:
chen: I'm down for a confetti jar. Also voting: cake, cookies, or sparkling water? react with :cake:, :cookie:, :sweat_drops:
sam: :cake: all the way
maya: I'll order cupcakes for SF office, and send a Zoom link for remote folks. anyone allergic to dairy?
diego: i'm vegan — appreciate a dairy-free option pls
leah: putting together a 5-minute shoutouts doc. ping me any names/notes. tag me w/ short bullet pls.
ops-bot: Automated milestone notice — total_requests=20000000, peak_rps=4200, p95_latency=120ms. Congrats team! :robot_face:
maya: also thinking of making a silly sash for whoever's on-call when we hit the number. nominations? :crown:
sam: nominate @diego for keeping things steady during the burst :clap:
diego: I'll pass the sash to whoever pushed the scaling patch — @maya? :grin:
leah: short toast on Zoom at 4pm PT? 5 mins. can we do that and then drop a gif? :sparkles:
maya: 4pm PT works. I'll post calendar invite + link. remote welcome!
chen: thanks all — this is a big one for product and infra. tiny ask: can we add a blurb to the release notes about performance improvements? helps marketing.
sam: good idea. i'll dm @marco to add a line.
maya: ok team — proud of y'all. bring your confetti and your best gifs. :partyparrot:
diego: GIF drop: https://giphy.com/gifs/confetti-happy-3oEduQAsYcJKQH2XsI
leah: sending the shoutouts doc link in a moment.
